subject: Campaign Compliance Reminder - $position Election
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

This is a reminder about campaign compliance requirements for the $position election:

📋 REQUIREMENTS:
• All campaign materials must be submitted for approval
• Campaign spending must not exceed £100.00
• Receipts must be provided for all expenses
• Materials must comply with election guidelines

📅 IMPORTANT DATES:
• Election ends: $voting_end
• Final compliance check: 24 hours before election end

Please ensure all requirements are met to avoid disqualification.

Best regards,
Election Commission
